Vegan Orange Cream Milkshake

May 28, 2026 by Lisa Le Leave a Comment

Jump to Recipe Print Recipe
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:45
Instaread

This vegan orange cream milkshake recipe is simple, no frills. Just 3 ingredients to make a creamy, refreshing orange creamsicle milkshake.

Recently I’ve had an influx of oranges come in my OddBunch boxes, but my kid has been hot and cold with fresh oranges as a snack. One day, I had the hankering for an Orange Julius. When I looked up the recipe there were so many variations, asking for orange juice concentrate and sugar?! Sometimes, we just gotta keep things simple.

Enter: the vegan orange cream milkshake, or what I can describe as a vegan creamsicle in smoothie form. SO GOOD. So fresh. So simple.

Read more: Vegan Orange Cream Milkshake

Unrelated, I had heard that juice concentrates were going to be discontinued?! That is key in so many of my punch recipes. I don’t know what I’m going to do now. They were so convenient for parties and BBQs.

Recipe Notes

If you’re wondering if you can make substitutions, like orange juice instead of oranges, or milk instead of ice cream, the answer is of course! It just won’t quite taste the same. The sweetness from the ice cream plus the ice help give this vegan orange cream milkshake a thick, creamy texture, and the fresh orange is what brings this to the next level. But if you must, here are my suggestions:

Ice cream substitutions: Use some vegan coffee creamer with a plant-based milk for the creaminess that ice cream would give. You may need to supplement with 1-2 tbsp of sugar to offset the sugar that the ice cream had.

Fresh Oranges Substitutions: You can use orange juice from a carton or from concentrate, but the second best thing is some fresh squeezed orange juice (like from the fresh counter at the grocery store).

Print Recipe

Vegan Orange Creamsicle Milkshake

With 2 ingredients plus ice, this treat is so refreshing and creamy! Fresh oranges give it irreplaceable bright, fresh flavour. It's our favourite summer treat!
Prep Time15 minutes mins
Course: Dessert, Drinks
Cuisine: Vegan
Keyword: vegan creamsicle, vegan cream milkshake, milkshake
Servings: 3 1 cup servings

Equipment

  • 1 high speed blender If you just have a regular powered blender, you may need to juice oranges instead of using peeled ones.

Ingredients

  • 5 medium oranges peeled, core cut out
  • 1 cup plant-based vanilla ice cream coconut or cashew based
  • 1 cup ice

Instructions

  • Cut off the peel of all the oranges, and cut out any really thick parts of the membrane (usually the centre). This takes the longest part, but the added fibre is worth it.
    5 medium oranges
  • Add the peeled oranges, plant-based ice cream, and ice into a high-speed blender. Blend on "Smoothie" mode if your blender has it, otherwise just blend until everything is smooth and homogeneous.
  • Pour and serve! Enjoy :)

Notes

If you don’t have a high speed blender, a regular blender might not break up the membrane of the oranges enough. You may be better off juicing, but don’t omit the pulpy bits! Add them right into the blender.
Also definitely do not omit the ice. I made this once without the ice and it was definitely not as good. Enjoy!
